# ADR-3108: A09: Documented sampling strategy for high-volume trace 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Full fidelity can be unaffordable.

## Decision

Observability teams MAY adopt a documented sampling strategy for high-volume trace 12 (A09-12) when full capture is cost-prohibitive.

## Consequences

Security-critical events remain unsampled.
